ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Non-Browser Network Communication With Google API
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects a non-browser process interacting with the Google API which could indicate the use of a covert C2 such as Google Sheet C2 (GC2-sheet)
 Note: Unmapped fields: DestinationHostname

sequences.query: (DestinationHostname = RGX(".*drive\\\.googleapis\\\.com.*") OR DestinationHostname = RGX(".*oauth2\\\.googleapis\\\.com.*") OR DestinationHostname = RGX(".*sheets\\\.googleapis\\\.com.*") OR DestinationHostname = RGX(".*www\\\.googleapis\\\.com.*")) AND  NOT (process_path = "None" OR process_path = "") AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\chrome\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Google\\\\Drive\\ File\\ Stream\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\GoogleDriveFS\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Mozilla\\ Firefox\\\\firefox\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Mozilla\\ Firefox\\\\firefox\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Internet\\ Explorer\\\\iexplore\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Internet\\ Explorer\\\\iexplore\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = RGX("\\\\maxthon\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeWebView\\\\Application\\\\.*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\Edge\\\\Application\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\\\Edge\\\\Application\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WindowsApps\\\\MicrosoftEdge\\\.exe$"))) OR ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\.*")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedgewebview2\\\.exe$"))) OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\safari\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\seamonkey\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whale\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\GoogleUpdate\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$"))
